intro.title: Merge Sorted Arrays
intro.body: In this lesson, you will build a function that merges two already-sorted arrays into a single sorted array. You will learn the core concept of the two-pointer technique, a common algorithmic pattern for efficiently processing sorted data. The main technologies involved are JavaScript arrays, while loops, and conditional logic. This beginner-friendly exercise will help you practice comparing elements and building a result step-by-step.
intro.usecase: The merge sorted arrays algorithm is essential in data processing scenarios where you need to combine multiple sorted datasets into a single sorted result. This pattern appears in e-commerce platforms when merging product search results from different categories or filters into a unified, sorted display. It's also used in social media feeds that combine posts from multiple sources (friends, groups, followed pages) into a single chronological timeline. Database systems frequently employ this technique when merging results from sorted indexes during query execution.
